scope: Compiler: one warm-up run; Firefox: one index build and 1000 warm-up requests followed by 10000 mixed matching/nonmatching image requests. Bun process only, no browser/network or Rust/WASM comparison. RSS covers the full process.
decision: Chrome/Brave retain native DNR. Firefox uses indexed JavaScript matching for observable block decisions, with native DNR for headers/allowances. Reconsider Rust/WASM only after a measured browser runtime bottleneck. These results do not compare language performance.
